command:
set -euo pipefail
H=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$H" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 - "$H" <<'PY'
import json,re,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; t=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read(); c={}
m=re.search(r'const\s+KOPF_ROLL_AUGEN_OFFSET\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\}\s*;',t,re.S)
pairs={}
if m:
  for x in re.finditer(r'[\"\'](-?\d+)[\"\']\s*:\s*\{\s*dx\s*:\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*,\s*dy\s*:\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*\}',m.group(1)):
    pairs[int(x.group(1))]=(float(x.group(2)),float(x.group(3)))
exp=list(range(-25,26,5)); c['offset_keys_exact']=sorted(pairs)==exp; c['neutral_zero']=pairs.get(0)==(0.0,0.0)
loop=re.search(r'function\s+schleife\(t\)\s*\{(.*?)requestAnimationFrame',t,re.S); body=loop.group(1) if loop else ''
c['same_frame_order']=0 <= body.find('kopfRollTick(t)') < body.find('kopfKoerperDrehSchritt()')
c['pose_commit_present']='kopfRollWert = schritt.w' in t
c['atomic_roll_binding']='kopfRollAusgleichDeg = kopfRollWert' in t
c['blink_shared_offset']='augenOffsetDx * _kopfCanvasScale' in t and 'augenOffsetDy * _kopfCanvasScale' in t
c['glow_shared_offset']='dx + augenOffsetDx * _kopfCanvasScale' in t and 'dy + augenOffsetDy * _kopfCanvasScale' in t
c['shared_rotation']=t.count('rotate(${kopfRollAusgleichDeg.toFixed(2)}deg)') >= 2
c['neck_origin']='transform-origin:50% 58.59%' in t
ok=all(c.values())
print(json.dumps({'schema':'FRANK_AVATAR_ROLL_ANCHOR_SOURCE_COHERENCE/v1','ok':ok,'offsets':pairs,'checks':c,'scope':'LIVE_SOURCE_READ_ONLY_NOT_PERCEPTUAL_PROMOTION'},sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$H" | awk '{print $1}')
echo BEFORE_SHA=$BEFORE
echo AFTER_SHA=$AFTER
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
